subject: executor: Optimize hash join/agg for `__bin` collator (#63509)
summary: Reviewed only 6e98fded vs first parent, scoped to executor hash join/agg key serialization/hashing. Change is a mechanical switch from `Collator.Key`/`ConvertByCollation` to `Collator.ImmutableKey` to avoid extra allocations for binary collations (notably `binCollator`/`derivedBinCollator` returning `hack.Slice`), plus corresponding interface plumbing and tests asserting `Key` == `ImmutableKey`. All updated call sites either immediately copy the key bytes (`Encode*`/`append`) or consume them synchronously (`hash.Hash64.Write`), so the unsafe no-copy slice does not escape or get mutated; no correctness/SQL-semantics/concurrency Blocker/High issues found in executor scope, and upstream/master later history shows no subsequent changes specifically adjusting/fixing this behavior.
